note: Synthetic organization and queries for retrieval evaluation only. Query categories: keyword (exact names), agentic (long, precise, sometimes quoted), paraphrase (little word overlap). Items without cases are distractors that share vocabulary with the targets.

canary-exploratory.proposition: Treat single-region canary results as exploratory until at least four independent environments are validated.
canary-exploratory.rationale: Many instances in one region are not independent evidence that a rollout is safe everywhere.

staged-rollout.proposition: Changes that alter customer data ship through staged rollouts of 1%, 10%, 50%, then 100%.
staged-rollout.rationale: Data corruption is expensive to reverse, so exposure grows only after each stage looks healthy.

rollout-freeze.proposition: No production rollouts between December 20 and January 3 except security fixes.
rollout-freeze.rationale: Staffing is thin over the period and recovery from a bad rollout takes longer.

feature-flags.proposition: Remove feature flags within 30 days of a feature reaching a 100% rollout.
feature-flags.rationale: Stale flags multiply code paths and have caused two production incidents.

postgres-only.proposition: PostgreSQL is the only supported database for services; embedded SQLite fallbacks were removed.
postgres-only.rationale: Supporting two databases doubled migration work and hid production-only bugs.

abandoned-mongodb.proposition: Migrating the ledger service to MongoDB.
abandoned-mongodb.rationale: The migration was evaluated for flexible schemas during the 2025 ledger rewrite.
abandoned-mongodb.reason: Multi-document transactions were too slow for reconciliation batches.

db-migration-owner.proposition: Schema migrations on the ledger database need a named database owner on call during the deploy window.
db-migration-owner.rationale: A failed migration once left the ledger locked for an hour with nobody able to roll back.

read-replica.proposition: Reporting queries may read from replicas despite up to five minutes of replication lag.
read-replica.rationale: Reports are reviewed daily, so slightly stale numbers are acceptable and protect the primary.

embeddings-model.proposition: Use bge-small-en-v1.5 for local embeddings; hosted embedding APIs are not allowed for customer text.
embeddings-model.rationale: Customer text must not leave our infrastructure, and the small model runs on CPU.

pii-logging.proposition: Never log raw email addresses or phone numbers; hash them with the per-tenant salt.
pii-logging.rationale: Logs are retained longer and accessed more widely than the primary customer store.

retention.proposition: Delete raw support transcripts after 90 days and keep only approved summaries.
retention.rationale: Transcripts contain personal data that is rarely needed after a ticket closes.

eu-residency.proposition: Data for EU customers must stay in the Frankfurt region, including backups.
eu-residency.rationale: Contracts with EU customers require in-region storage for every copy of their data.

abandoned-graphql.proposition: Offering a public GraphQL API to partners.
abandoned-graphql.rationale: Partners asked for flexible queries across accounts and invoices.
abandoned-graphql.reason: Query cost was unbounded and complexity-based rate limits confused partners.

api-versioning.proposition: Version the public REST API in the URL path, such as /v2/, and support each version for 18 months.
api-versioning.rationale: Path versions are visible in logs and easy for partners to pin.

oncall-handoff.proposition: On-call handoff happens Mondays at 10:00 Oslo time with a written incident summary.
oncall-handoff.rationale: Verbal handoffs lost context about open incidents twice last quarter.

incident-sev1.proposition: A Sev1 incident requires a status page update within 15 minutes of declaration.
incident-sev1.rationale: Customers learned about the March outage from social media before we posted anything.

hiring-takehome.proposition: Take-home coding assignments for backend candidates.
hiring-takehome.rationale: Take-home work was meant to reduce interviewer load.
hiring-takehome.reason: Completion fell below 40% and the format favored candidates with free time.

pricing-annual.proposition: Annual plans get a 15% discount; monthly plans get none.
pricing-annual.rationale: Annual commitments reduce churn and smooth cash flow.

churn-belief.proposition: An onboarding call in the first week, not price, is the strongest predictor of 90-day retention.
churn-belief.rationale: The cohort analysis showed price changes had little effect while onboarding calls doubled retention.

ml-eval-holdout.proposition: Model evaluations must use the frozen 2026-Q1 holdout set, and nobody tunes against it.
ml-eval-holdout.rationale: Tuning on the holdout inflated reported accuracy by six points last year.

gpu-spot.proposition: Training jobs may use spot GPUs only if they checkpoint at least every 30 minutes.
gpu-spot.rationale: Spot capacity is half the price but can be reclaimed at any time.

vendor-security.proposition: New vendors that process customer data need a security review before contract signature.
vendor-security.rationale: Reviews after signing left us without leverage to require fixes.

bm25-agent.proposition: Agent-facing search uses BM25 first, adding embeddings only when an eval shows a gain.
bm25-agent.rationale: Agents write precise queries, and lexical ranking is cheaper and easier to explain.

mobile-min-version.proposition: Mobile apps force-upgrade clients older than two minor versions.
mobile-min-version.rationale: Supporting old clients kept deprecated API endpoints alive for years.

rollout-dashboards.proposition: Every production rollout links its monitoring dashboard in the deploy ticket.
rollout-dashboards.rationale: Reviewers could not find the right graphs during a bad rollout.

canary-metrics.proposition: Canary analysis compares error rate and p99 latency against the baseline fleet.
canary-metrics.rationale: Error rate alone missed a latency regression in one region.

ledger-backups.proposition: Ledger database backups are restored into staging every week to prove they work.
ledger-backups.rationale: An untested backup failed to restore during the 2024 incident.

customer-data-exports.proposition: Customer data exports are generated asynchronously and expire after seven days.
customer-data-exports.rationale: Large synchronous exports timed out and links were shared indefinitely.

api-rate-limits.proposition: Public REST API rate limits are 600 requests per minute per partner key.
api-rate-limits.rationale: One partner's batch job degraded the API for everyone else.

incident-postmortem.proposition: Every Sev1 and Sev2 incident gets a blameless postmortem within five business days.
incident-postmortem.rationale: Follow-up actions were forgotten when postmortems slipped.

support-escalation.proposition: Support escalates customer tickets to engineering only through the triage rotation.
support-escalation.rationale: Direct pings interrupted engineers and bypassed prioritization.

search-reindex.proposition: Search indexes are rebuilt nightly from the primary database.
search-reindex.rationale: Incremental updates drifted from the source of truth.

vendor-renewals.proposition: Vendor contracts renew annually and finance reviews them in October.
vendor-renewals.rationale: Auto-renewals locked us into unused tools.

mobile-release-train.proposition: Mobile apps ship on a two-week release train.
mobile-release-train.rationale: Ad hoc releases made app store review delays unpredictable.

ml-feature-store.proposition: Model features are read from the feature store and never recomputed in notebooks.
ml-feature-store.rationale: Notebook features silently diverged from production features.

gpu-quotas.proposition: Each team's quota is capped at eight on-demand GPUs.
gpu-quotas.rationale: One training run consumed the whole cluster for a week.

data-deletion.proposition: Customer data deletion requests complete within 30 days across all systems, including backups.
data-deletion.rationale: Regulators require deletion everywhere a copy of the data exists.

oncall-pager.proposition: On-call engineers acknowledge pages within five minutes during their shift.
oncall-pager.rationale: Slow acknowledgements stretched a Sev1 outage by forty minutes.

schema-review.proposition: Database schema changes need review from the data platform team before merge.
schema-review.rationale: Unreviewed indexes caused write amplification on the primary.

pricing-enterprise.proposition: Enterprise plans are priced per seat with a minimum of 50 seats.
pricing-enterprise.rationale: Small enterprise deals cost more to support than they earned.
